### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **16** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/runtime/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**9** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/api/index.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`  _(via MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/permissions/sharing-rules.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx`  _(via SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (literal, a string literal in handleInstall))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/runtime/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **32** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a727ba26b17280bc5f3cdd9a9d6addbc5356389a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8b59bdef9aa40458b8b950c1a4b2f6e08d3bde0e` — the merge of head `039a82db8075949ddf17955460b14673445d3366` into base `a727ba26b17280bc5f3cdd9a9d6addbc5356389a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8b59bdef9aa40458b8b950c1a4b2f6e08d3bde0e && git checkout 8b59bdef9aa40458b8b950c1a4b2f6e08d3bde0e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a727ba26b17280bc5f3cdd9a9d6addbc5356389a 039a82db8075949ddf17955460b14673445d3366 && git checkout -B drift-repro a727ba26b17280bc5f3cdd9a9d6addbc5356389a && git merge --no-ff 039a82db8075949ddf17955460b14673445d3366

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a727ba26b17280bc5f3cdd9a9d6addbc5356389a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a727ba26b17280bc5f3cdd9a9d6addbc5356389a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `039a82db8075949ddf17955460b14673445d3366`
Local-runs: none

Face: the declaration face alone (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` in the changeset at this head). There is no `packages/spec/src/**` path and no governed path, so per `contract-review.md` the record is the lane seat's at `TIER_DEFAULT`. Inputs: card #28143, claim 6542814313 and amendment, the os-dev-report 6543432410, the source diff read whole at `6aa099f6af`, and the one-file delta to this head (the changeset only).

### ① Derived judgments

- **`datasourceNameHolder` and `DatasourceNameHolding` (new exports from `@objectstack/runtime`)**: right. Additive; no existing export changes. The judge reads, in order, the host's `default`, the metadata registry (an item stamped with this package is its own), the names other installed packages recorded and the host's code-datasource set, then the data engine's drivers. A read that throws is `unreadable`, never `free`; a service the kernel lacks holds nothing. One judge serves both the install door and the rehydrate, as the card asks.
- **Install door, 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with `details: { datasource, reading }` (new answer)**: right. It replaces the old fail-open `continue` (card edge 1), runs before any write, and uses an error code the spec's API vocabulary already carries. A runtime without the judge also answers 503 rather than skipping the check.
- **Install door, engine-only holder now 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`**: right. It is the existing refusal applied to a holder the old check missed (edge 2), not a new code.
- **Rehydrate (`connectPackageDatasources`, installed call)**: right. Names are judged after the package's own earlier registrations are withdrawn, so what still holds a name is another holder's. A held or unreadable name is left out of the registration, the code set, the record and the connect, with one `error` line naming it and the remedy (edge 3). With nothing left out, the boot's list is still handed over by reference (#23029's identity pin).
- **Uninstall**: right. Withdrawal disconnects only pools the package's own connect opened; one answered `already-registered` is recorded as found and left to its holder.
- **Nothing else moves**: no `packages/spec` path, stored column, metadata key or route added. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.

### ② Semver level

- **`@objectstack/runtime` patch, `@objectstack/cloud-connection` patch**: accepted. A non-protocol widening ships `patch` under AGENTS.md's changeset rule, and the changeset at this head names the widening in one sentence.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **PR body line `Clause-②: no`**: stale. The changeset at this head and the claim amendment are the declaration of record; the ACCEPT records the correction.
- **"install record"**: read as the runtime's per-package record; no marker on the persisted install record or listing. A marker there would be a new stored shape, so it is out of scope here and recorded in the ACCEPT.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-wziudv`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QUs3BtyH9zgxKzYrJiH18J`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** install-local 安装和重启后的 rehydrate 改用 runtime 里同一个判定 `datasourceNameHolder` 判断数据源名字归谁：它也读数据引擎，读不到时拒绝（503），被别人占用时 409；rehydrate 遇到别人占用的名字不再接管，只记一条 error 日志；卸载只关闭本包自己打开的连接池。
- **为什么改：** #28132 留下三个缺口：元数据读失败时放行安装、只注册在引擎上的数据源看不见、#28039 之前装的包在重启时会覆盖 Setup 里同名数据源，卸载时还会关掉 Setup 的连接池。
- **风险与回滚：** 新增两种拒绝（引擎占用 409、读不到 503），都发生在任何写入之前；rehydrate 只是跳过被占用的名字。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/runtime/src/declared-datasources.ts` 的 `datasourceNameHolder` 与 `leaveHeldNames`；`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 503 分支。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/declared-datasources.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-datasource-holder.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：一个判定服务安装和重启两条路，读失败按"未判定"拒绝而不是放行，卸载不再关别人的池；可合。

## 席位核对

- **Form:** 6 files, +595/-45. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28418`: NOT governed, 640 lines ≤ 3000, Tier S. Declaration of record: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (changeset at this head, claim amendment on #28143, TIER_DEFAULT review 6543485690 PASS at this head). `Metadata-protocol: none` holds. Both packages `patch`.
- **Premise measured:** the dev measured all three edges standing on `main` `75ecaf4a` (read fault 200, engine-only holder 200, rehydrate took over a Setup row and uninstall disconnected a found pool). Seat read the source diff whole; the judgments are in the review.
- **Gates (check-runs at the pinned head):** 48 runs: 35 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending; mergeable, clean. Dev: 60/60 gates exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED, `pnpm lint` 0; runtime 8010 and cloud-connection 768 tests green with typecheck; install-local dogfood 8/8; three ablations red as predicted.
- **Accepted deviations:** `packages/runtime/src/index.ts` is outside the claimed surface; it carries only the export line the door needs. The PR body still says `Clause-②: no`; the relay cannot patch the body, so this record and the changeset are the declaration of record.
- **Out of scope and where it goes:** "install record" is read as the runtime's per-package record. No marker is written on the persisted install record or listing for a name the rehydrate left alone; that would be a new stored shape and is not owed here. `Skills-docs: none`.
- **Landing clause:** Tier S ordinary queue landing. The seat flips ready and enables auto-merge through the relay, then confirms MERGED and closes out #28143.
